debrisIds: ledger (no manual debris); DebrisLayer gets the same pose as Camera, mural forms by itself in hook3
localProps: HookBrowser (BrowserWindow copy with the symmetric tab bar centred on the window instead of after the traffic lights)
HookLyric (HookType-style card with a fixed two-row break and fit-to-width size)
promotionCandidates: BrowserWindow: option to centre the symmetric tab bar on the window axis (lib version puts the active tab ~55 px right of centre)
HookType: size/width/top-anchor overrides or a balanced two-row break; at 140 px most hook lines wrap and line .03 would need 3 rows
GagWindow-style mini AppWindow with an in-picture label chip
notes: Hook type: hooks 1-2 and hook3 lines .01-.04 use HookLyric top-anchored at y 230 (inside the window content, so the tab bar and the held cursor stay clear), size min(80+60*intensity, fit) = 104/122/<=140. From h3.05 (startFrame-4) hook3 switches to the lib HookType(intensity 1, y 140, beatPulse 0.4), i.e. LyricCard size 140 y 140, which is exactly what the outro holds at its first frame. That card wraps to two rows and reaches about screen y 305, slightly into the mural top band; it is the outro-agreed seam. Last frame (4538) is exactly MURAL_POSE, muralAt=1, no window, cursor or orbiters left; ConfettiField orbit spin 2. Tails of hook1/hook2 hold the image and the h.08 card; the next section pickups are not shown. Window punch on bar downbeats scales the window around the active tab (amount 0.01+0.03*intensity) so the tab stays under the still cursor. Active tab centre is at x 964 (HOOK_WINDOW is content-box, its centre is 964). Gag budget: 4 literal per hook (same gags recur). In hook3, keys and lunch are sung during the pull-back, so they appear in screen space at mirrored lower-left/right positions instead of on the loops.
